description: The Cases actions as typed sub-blocks, each with its catch-all: get_case with case_request_fields of system field ids, case_response_fields holding a casefield reference key ("casefield:priority") beside system field ids, and its ContactNotLinked, MultipleFound and NoneFound branches before the catch-all when linking, or the two lookups alone when not; update_case with case_id a JSONPath and a casefield reference key beside a system field id, linking the current contact; create_case with case_template_id a casetemplate reference key and case_request_fields a map whose keys are casefield reference keys beside literal system field ids (customer_id, summary), the linking block with contact_to_link and its ContactNotLinked branch, the other without either. The templates and fields are bound in refs to awscc_connectcases resources (hashicorp/aws has none). Awaits the provider release that carries these blocks and the reference key rule (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
